statement: Any process expected to outlive one sitting runs inside a compose service with resource caps. Bare-host long-runners are violations, detected by the patrol, not forgiven by prose.

gstd_tunnel_amendment.law: the gstd quick-tunnel cloudflared (bare-host, log logs/gstd_quicktunnel.log) is a THIS-SITTING exception: trycloudflare URLs are ephemeral so the process has no reboot-survival value; cloudflared.exe is not in watch_process_names so the patrol never kills it and only this row alerts; the persistent form (named tunnel, or compose sidecar mirroring reference/gstdcoin/gstdbot/tunnel.sh) is an operator call; when the tunnel dies the stale GSTD_PUBLIC_URL in docker-compose.override.yml must be refreshed (docker exec gstd-node write of /tmp/gstd_tunnel_url.txt is the no-restart lever) or cleared

disk_free_floor_gb.law: the patrol fails exit 1 and appends memory/attention.md when a watch path's volume free space is below floor_gb; founding incident: C: hit 6.1GB free at 100 percent on 2026-10-08 with ledgers live while the operator asked twice what was happening (receipt watch/inbox/DISK_INVENTORY_20261008.md); relief came from ollama rotation, not luck
disk_free_floor_gb.reversible_relief_playbook: docker builder prune -f (cache only), then ollama rotation of registry models with modelfile receipts banked (watch/inbox/model_modelfiles_20261008/), then cloud offload of cold artifacts - never delete live ledgers

ml_advisory_head.law: advisory only: ML rows go to stdout plus logs/longrunner_ml_advisory.jsonl and never append to memory/attention.md and never change the patrol exit code; the rule-based scan stays the enforcement surface
